items.headline: New Energy Roadmap Prioritises Domestic Coal, Gas, and Solar Resources
bullets: The government has devised an updated energy roadmap recalibrating power generation toward indigenous resources—domestic coal, offshore/onshore gas, and utility-scale solar—to reduce dependency on costly imported fuels.
The strategic pivot seeks to ease severe foreign exchange constraints caused by high import bills for liquefied natural gas (LNG) and exorbitant capacity charges paid to private power producers.
The policy aligns with the objectives of the Perspective Plan 2041 and the Integrated Energy and Power Master Plan (IEPMP) to secure energy sovereignty and long-term fiscal sustainability.
keyFacts: Primary Energy Targets: Domestic coal, local natural gas, and solar power
Key Objective: Curtailing costly imported LNG and heavy fuel oil (HFO)
Policy Anchor: Integrated Energy and Power Master Plan (IEPMP) / Perspective Plan 2041

items.headline: India Proposes Anti-Dumping Duty on PET Film Imports from Bangladesh
bullets: India's Directorate General of Trade Remedies (DGTR) has initiated recommendations for imposing anti-dumping duty on Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET) film originating from Bangladesh following domestic manufacturer petitions.
The prospective trade barrier presents a setback for Bangladesh's export diversification agenda, impacting non-garment manufacturing sectors dependent on the Indian market.
The measure highlights compliance challenges under World Trade Organization (WTO) trade remedy agreements as Bangladesh prepares for LDC graduation by 2026.
keyFacts: Investigating Body: Directorate General of Trade Remedies (DGTR), India
Governing Framework: WTO Agreement on Implementation of Article VI of GATT 1994

items.headline: Geopolitical Tensions Mount Around Bab el-Mandeb Amid Escalating Yemen Conflict
bullets: Heightened military manoeuvres and cross-border assaults on energy installations between Saudi forces and Houthi rebels have brought the vital Bab el-Mandeb maritime corridor back into high geopolitical focus.
The Bab el-Mandeb Strait represents one of the world's most critical maritime chokepoints, handling roughly 10% of global seaborne petroleum transit and linking the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden.
Protracted instability in this corridor threatens international shipping supply chains, inflates marine freight and war-risk insurance premiums, and exerts upward pressure on global crude prices.
keyFacts: Connecting Waters: Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden (leading to the Indian Ocean)
Key Belligerents: Saudi-led coalition and the Houthi movement (Ansar Allah)

items.headline: Bangkok Declares Disaster Zones Across All 50 Districts Following Severe Inundation
bullets: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration declared all 50 city districts disaster emergency areas after unprecedented monsoon downpours overwhelmed the city's drainage infrastructure.
The event underscores the acute vulnerability of low-lying deltaic Asian metropolises to compound climate risks, including sea-level rise, ground subsidence, and intense pluvial flooding.
The disaster provides administrative case-study value for disaster risk reduction (DRR) and urban resilience strategies under the Sendai Framework 2015–2030.
keyFacts: River System: Chao Phraya River basin
Global Accord: Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction (2015–2030)

বাংলাদেশ প্রস্তাবের পক্ষে ভোট দিয়ে তাৎক্ষণিক যুদ্ধবিরতি ও পূর্ণাঙ্গ ত্রাণ সরবরাহের আহ্বান পুনর্ব্যক্ত করেছে।
জাতিসংঘের আন্তর্জাতিক বিচার আদালতের (ICJ) মতামতের আলোকে এই কূটনৈতিক উদ্যোগ গ্রহণ করা হয়।
items.sourceHeadline: জাতিসংঘে ফিলিস্তিন বিষয়ক ঐতিহাসিক প্রস্তাব পাস
items.excerpt: জাতিসংঘের সাধারণ পরিষদে আন্তর্জাতিক বিচার আদালতের ঐতিহাসিক রায় বাস্তবায়নের দাবিতে বিপুল সংখ্যাগরিষ্ঠতায় প্রস্তাব অনুমোদিত হয়েছে।

mcqs.question: আন্তর্জাতিক বিচার আদালত (ICJ) কোন শহরে অবস্থিত?
ব্যাংক হিসাবের মধ্যে সরাসরি ইলেকট্রনিক অর্থ স্থানান্তরের জন্য বাংলাদেশ ব্যাংক কোন ব্যবস্থা ব্যবহার করে?
